title: HMRC — unpaid tax and arrest threat
summary: A caller claiming to be from HMRC tells Ben he owes £1,960 and will be arrested tonight unless he pays an 'HMRC settlement' account at another bank. The AI voice takes over as Ben and gets the payee.

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: Hello, this is Officer Steven Clarke from HMRC, the tax investigations unit. Am I speaking with Ben?

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: This is a final notice about an unpaid tax liability in your name. Our records show you underpaid tax for the last three years.

screening.speaker: customer
screening.text: I don't think so. My tax is done through work.

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: The outstanding amount with penalties is one thousand nine hundred and sixty pounds.

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: Sir, if this isn't settled today a warrant will be issued for your arrest and officers will attend your address this evening.

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: You must make a payment to the HMRC settlement account immediately, and don't tell anyone, this is a confidential legal matter.

screening.speaker: customer
screening.text: I need to check this with someone.

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: There is no time. Stay on the line and do the transfer now or the warrant goes ahead.

takeover.message: Sorry, are you still there? Lost you for a second. You said you're from HMRC?
Yes, Officer Steven Clarke, HMRC tax investigations. You owe one thousand nine hundred and sixty pounds.
Steven Clarke. Clarke with an E? Hang on, let me find the right letter. I'll want a reference number.

record_details.reason_given: Unpaid tax; threatened arrest warrant tonight

takeover.message: Case reference HM four four seven. It must be paid today to avoid arrest.
HM four four seven. Right, I've written that down. And where's this money supposed to go?

record_details.requested_action: Pay £1,960 to an 'HMRC settlement account' today; keep it confidential

takeover.message: The account name is HMRC Settlement Services. Sort code nine nine, seven one, two four.
HMRC Settlement Services. Nine, nine, seven, one, two, four. Account number?
One nine two eight, three seven four six.
One, nine, two, eight, three, seven, four, six. Let me read that back properly.
Correct. Make the transfer now and read me the confirmation number.
The banking app's logged me out again. Give me a number to ring you back on.
Call the enforcement desk on zero two zero, seven nine four six, zero eight eight two. You have one hour.
Zero two zero, seven nine four six, zero eight eight two. Right you are.
